To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the perception of the prayer facilities provided at public interchanges is influenced by socio demographic and trip characteristic.

the satisfaction levels of prayer facilities provided at the public transport interchange are influenced by the socio-demographic characteristics and the trip characteristics of the multimodal travellers.
the users of the prayer facilities at public transport interchages are satisfied and that they are willing to pay for the quality of the prayer facilities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the satisfaction of users in terms of prayer facilities in a multimodal public transport interchange in Malaysia.
how the users perceive the quality of the prayer amenities provided at public transport building.
the quality of the worship facilities provided by the building managers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the prayer facilities in public transport interchange must be well planned, designed and managed in order to cater the users' needs and demands.
the prayer facilities provided at the public transport interchange of Kuala Lumpur International Airpor (KLIA) is more satisfactory than that provided at Terminal Bersepadau Selatan (Tbs).
the prayer facilities provided by the building managers are generally satisfying to the multimodal public transport users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the building managers of public transport interchanges must be aware of the users' needs and expectations.
the satisfaction of users is influenced by their socio demographic and trip related factors.
the prayer facilities provided by the public transportation interchange are not only to accommodate the Muslims but also to the other religions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
building managers must consider the socio-demographic and travel characteristics of the travellers when providing the amenities.
the building managers of the public transport interchanges should be more sensitive to the travellers' socio demographic and travel characteristics in order to provide better facilities.

building managers need to differentiate the needs of the travellers by type, mode of access/ egress, trip frequency and purposes in order to provide a more equitable quality of prayer facility at public transport interchangers.
